# telnyx_available_phone_number_blocks (Data Source)

Blocks of consecutive phone numbers available to order, found by the given filters.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_country_code` (String) Filter phone numbers by country.
- `filter_locality` (String) Filter phone numbers by city.
- `filter_national_destination_code` (String) Filter by the national destination code of the number.
- `filter_phone_number_type` (String) Filter phone numbers by number type. One of `local`, `mobile`, `national`, `shared_cost`, `toll_free`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `available_phone_number_blocks` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--available_phone_number_blocks))
